notes.title: Rakuen vs. Mr. Saitou: What to Expect
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27110155/597d0628102bcbc70c1c80db841dfab7843b6009.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

First of all, I wanted to thank you for the love and support that you've shown me over the years. Every day I'm thankful and honored that I'm able to create music and games in the hopes of moving people in a positive direction. This is a dream come true for me, and I'm so moved every time someone shares that Rakuen has helped them somehow. 

I wanted to address something about Mr. Saitou before the game comes out tomorrow. I've seen a lot of people joking about how (based off of their experience with Rakuen) they're preparing to be "emotionally destroyed" by Mr. Saitou (or other references to lots of crying :) - While I definitely appreciate that Rakuen resonated with people, I want to make 100% sure that folks don't have the wrong impression about what kind of game Mr. Saitou is. 

While Mr. Saitou takes place in the same universe as Rakuen, it's meant to be playable in one sitting (around 2-3 hours as compared to 6-10), and it's more of a quirky and lighthearted game (it's *not* an emotional roller coaster spanning multiple character arcs). The game focuses on a friendship between an overworked Japanese salaryman and a goofy extroverted kid. The characters are silly, there's a lot of poking fun at corporate business culture, and some of the stupid parts make me laugh. For those who have played Rakuen, Mr. Saitou serves as a fun enhancement of that world, rather than a direct sequel.

That being said, there is an underlying heavy topic and some bittersweet moments (which do cause me personally to tear up when I'm playtesting), but it's approached in a more subtle manner than the topics in Rakuen. While Rakuen is a story about accepting and understanding tragic fates, Mr. Saitou is a story about growing beyond yourself to find meaning and purpose in loving others. Despite being a short game, we put a lot of love into it. You can interact with most things, there's lots of hand-drawn portrait art, colorful pixel art & animations, and a varied musical score (from Enka to Hip Hop with a callback to a certain Sunflower through whom many of you came to know me).

Mr. Saitou means a lot to me. It's kind of my love letter to the introvert world, and to my community. It's silly, with a bit of serious. And I really hope that even though it's not going to be as long or as intense as Rakuen, that it will still be a good and uplifting experience for you.

Thank-you for playing ❤️
--laura (a.k.a. supershigi)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/628740/Mr_Saitou/

notes.title: You're invited to the Open Beta for Rakuen's New Engine!
notes.content:
[h2]New Engine Open Beta![/h2]

Hi everyone! I'm super excited to announce that we've spent the last year creating an entirely new custom-built engine (powered by Ebitengine) that will solve many of the issues inherent to RPG Maker XP while enabling us to bring Rakuen to other systems (like Switch and mobile devices) + some other goodies! [b]The new build is now in open beta and available to anyone who owns the game![/b]

[h3]🌳Update Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Overall improved performance
[*]Resizable window & borderless windowed fullscreen mode
[*]No more blurring of pixels when the game window is expanded--nice, crisp pixel art!
[*]Steam Deck compatibility (with improved controller/touchscreen support)
[*]Fixed the RPG Maker XP issue where clicking off the game disrupts audio-synchronized cutscenes
[*]Steam Achievements now compatible with Mac/Linux/Steam Deck
[*]On-screen lyrics subtitles for translations
[*]New art, character animations, and smoother graphics.
[*]Original build will still be accessible to those who are using older machines.
[/list][h3]🌳Improved Livestream Experience:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Pixel perfect game window resizing for StreamlabsOBS (or other streaming software)
[*]Audio-synchronized cutscenes will no longer be interrupted by stream alerts
[*]Streamers can switch tabs to chat on Twitch (or other platforms) without window issues
[/list]
[h3]🌳Accessing the Beta/Reporting Bugs:[/h3]
Because we want to ensure the best player experience possible, we're inviting all those who own the game to test the new engine before it's fully released. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/559210/discussions/4/]If you find any bugs, please report them in our Official Bug Forum.[/url] If you'd like to participate in the open beta, here's how you can access it: Right-click Rakuen in your Steam library. Go to "Properties" and click the "Betas" tab. From the drop-down menu, select "you-beta-test-this" and that's it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27110155/f812804311f40ffc03472055b2cc104df5ad4fe6.png[/img]

If you already own Rakuen, then this update will be [b]completely free to you[/b] (and will be available automatically once it's released)! Starting this Monday (2/13), in order to cover development costs for building the new engine, Rakuen's price will become 14.99. But of course, anyone who has the game by then will receive the update & new engine for free.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/628740/Mr_Saitou/?utm_source=stm
Lastly, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/628740/Mr_Saitou/]don't forget to check out the demo for Mr. Saitou (the next game in the Rakuen universe)[/url] before the end of Steam Next Fest (and to Wishlist & Follow for updates, contests, etc.) ❤️

notes.title: Five years after launch, heartfelt indie Rakuen is getting a 'major update' and spin-off
notes.content: In 2017, indie developer and composer Laura Shigihara released Rakuen, a delightful adventure-RPG about a sick boy and his mother who travel back and forth between a whimsical fantasy land and the somewhat less whimsical hospital where he's staying. Now, Shigihara has announced that Rakuen is getting a significant update, and a new game in the same setting will be released next year... Read more.

I really believe that everyone can be a hero through their kindness, whether it's a huge gesture, or something that seems like a random every day occurrence. notes.title: The world of adventure game Rakuen will be the setting of a new animated series
notes.content:
Rakuen is an affecting adventure game that flew under the radar a little when it was released last year, but has since racked up an Overwhelmingly Positive user review score on Steam. Its story of a hospitalized boy who travels to a storybook fantasy land with his mother captured a lot of hearts, and also a lot of tears.

Its creator Laura Shigihara has been working with animator Slamacow to create an original 3D animated series set in the world of Rakuen, which will be called The Farmer in the Sky. You can watch the trailer embedded above, and it looks cute as heck.

The Farmer in the Sky will debut on its own YouTube channel, and Rakuen is currently discounted by 40% to celebrate the announcement.

notes.title: Want to help translate Rakuen into your language?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27110155/e20568876b2e03a72c21426a0db45dce50174102.png[/img]
Attention bilingual (and multilingual) Rakuen fans: Would you like to help translate Rakuen into your language? We now have an official team managing the process! If you’d like to join, Andrii (the translation lead, who also organized the "Finding Paradise" translations) explains how to sign up in the quote below. Thanks so much for your help everyone^^ 
[quote]
Dear fans,
We are extremely glad that so many people want to see Rakuen in their language. That's why we decided to help you and ease all processes, so you can focus on translation.
Currently the game is already translated into Italian, Spanish, Korean and Chinese (Simplified), but all other languages are welcome.

Here is the form to register into translation: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc0BWr-eZ0zsPRptlcf2nf_E8AiF6L6aiu-JcASxMHN7j3waA/viewform?usp=sf_link

We will use SmartCAT (free online tool) for translation and Discord for communication.
If you're a registered in SmartCAT member, please use the same email and name, I will simply add you to the project.
If you're new user to SmartCAT, please write correct email as you will receive an invitation there. It's better to have ...gmail.com as some email providers do not receive notifications or consider it as a spam.

And here is a link to 'The Leeble Forest' Discord channel, where we will communicate: https://discordapp.com/invite/PDS3ctg
You will see only general channels and welcome page from Translation category, but after submitting the form above you will receive correspondent role and will see instructions and separate language channels.

And please be patient if you don't receive notifications and roles immediately, we will try to do it ASAP.[/quote]

notes.title: The 19th Humble Indie Bundle features existential horror & bullet time
notes.content:
While Humble may offer a lot of bundles now, their Humble Indie Bundles are what first put the site on the map. Their 19th went live last night, offering their usual broad and colourful cross-section of what the indie development scene has to offer.

Featuring space adventure, train-based puzzling, VR bomb defusal and one of the most existentially unsettling horror games ever made, this bundle has a little something for everybody, assuming you’re not a huge dork like me that automatically buys everything halfway interesting that crosses your path and already owns two thirds of these.

notes.title: How to Participate in the Rakuen Localization Beta!
notes.content:
Attention international fans: I'm excited to announce that thanks to the efforts of our wonderful fan translation teams, Rakuen has been localized into four new languages: Chinese (simplified), Italian, Korean, and Spanish! In order to bring you the best possible translations, we now humbly ask for your help...

For the next two weeks, the new language versions will be available to folks who already have Rakuen in their Steam library. We're looking for a few bilingual fans to help run through the game and report any errors they find. If you're interested in participating in the beta, please read the details below:

[h1]How to get the (Chinese/Italian/Korean/Spanish) version:[/h1]

Step 1: Right click Rakuen in your Steam library -> Properties -> Betas tab -> select 'test - Bugfixes will be tested here first', in the dropdown menu.

Step 2: Under Properties choose the Language tab -> select the language you're testing, and then simply wait for the new Rakuen files to download!

[h1]How to Report Errors:[/h1]

When you're ready to submit your errors, we'd appreciate if you compile them into a single post on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/559210/discussions/0/2741975115073247256/]Rakuen Translation thread.[/url]

We also have a [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/8fhEqFq]Discord server[/url] where folks can discuss about the new language versions in real time under the #rakuen-chat channel.

[h1]Can I help translate Rakuen into (insert language)?[/h1]

That would be wonderful, thank-you! If you'd like to help us translate Rakuen into your language, please let us know at the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/559210/discussions/0/2741975115073247256/]Translation thread[/url], or visit the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/8fhEqFq]Discord server[/url] for more details!

notes.title: Rakuen Soundtrack now available on iTunes!
notes.content:
[url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/album/rakuen-original-soundtrack/id1278159144][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27110155/d4b3c0d11879243e9ff2aea8fb18a34323601667.png[/img][/url]

Hi everyone! A lot of folks have been asking me about this, so... I'm super excited to finally announce that the complete [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/album/rakuen-original-soundtrack/id1278159144]Rakuen OST is now available on iTunes![/url] Within the next 1-2 weeks, we'll be rolling it out to other online stores like Spotify, Google Play, Amazon, etc.  

People have also been asking me, "How can we get Rakuen more exposure?" One of the *best* ways is to leave a Steam review! So if you played the game and enjoyed it, leaving a review (even a tiny 1-sentence one) would help us a lot! Especially now, since we're so close to hitting 500~! 

Take care and talk to you soon!

notes.content: Composer, performer and now developer Laura Shigihara s first game, Rakuen [official site], is out now, and it is something truly special. In a To The Moon sort of way. A hilarious and heartbreaking tale of loss and redemption, with songs. Here s wot I think: … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: To The Moon-inspired adventure Rakuen is out now
notes.content: Rakuen [official site], the first game from Laura Shigihara, has been five years in the making, and is out today. “Laura Shigihara?” you say, “I know that name from somewhere!” Indeed you do – Shigihara came to fame when she wrote and performed the fabulous song that accompanied the original Plants Vs Zombies. She has since composed and performed music for many independent games, perhaps most notably the gorgeous To The Moon – a game that was a big inspiration for Rakuen. … [visit site to read more]
